scripts.//playwright-path: Both commands below spell out ../../node_modules/.bin/playwright on purpose. Bare `playwright` resolves through this workspace's node_modules/.bin FIRST, so any dependency added here that brings its own `playwright` silently becomes the runner — while the specs keep importing the root @playwright/test. A mismatched pair fails as 'Playwright Test did not expect test.describe() to be called here' and then 'No tests found'; for install:browsers it is worse than a failure, since it would fetch a Chromium build for a version nothing runs. Root .bin/playwright is linked from @playwright/test itself, so runner and library always match. This bit us through @playwright/mcp, whose PRERELEASE `playwright` shadowed the runner here (#784); that devDependency is gone as of #819 — .claude/settings.json launches the MCP server as `npx @playwright/mcp@latest` and never needed it declared — but keep the explicit paths: they are what makes the next such dependency harmless.
